candidates.name: UBDC Airbnb Data Collection System
candidates.what_it_holds: Containerized scraper (Python, PostGIS-backed) run by University of Glasgow's Urban Big Data Centre since 2020, continuously harvesting Airbnb listing details, calendar availability, discovery of new listings, and guest reviews for user-defined geographic areas (GeoJSON/bbox/quadkey). Code only in the repo (58 commits); the raw scraped output itself (booking activity, customer reviews, spatial location, host status, amenities, 2020-2025, ~40 UK Travel-to-Work Areas) is archived separately at researchdata.gla.ac.uk (DOI 10.5525/gla.researchdata.2056) but is restricted to UBDC staff for non-commercial academic use only -- not downloadable by us.
candidates.why_useful: Longest-running, still-live daily Airbnb scrape we've found (since 2020, UK-focused), directly targeting reviews/bookings as a stays proxy -- fills gap #1/#2 in kind, but the actual data output is access-restricted so only the method is usable, and it scrapes airbnb.com directly (ToS question, flagged per repo rule 6, not run).
candidates.license: repo has LICENCE.txt (terms not confirmed); data restricted, non-commercial academic only
candidates.last_activity: not confirmed from fetch; repo has 58 commits, documentation recently updated

candidates.name: Tom Slee Airbnb Data Collection
candidates.what_it_holds: Python/PostgreSQL scraper (airbnb.py, airbnb_survey.py, DB schema) that Tom Slee used from 2013-2017 to survey Airbnb listings across many cities, predating Inside Airbnb. 250 commits, MIT license, no longer maintained (last real activity ~2019 per status notes). No CSV/DB dumps are committed in the repo itself -- code only; his separately-hosted survey archives (tomslee.net) reportedly cover survey dates 2014-09-24 through 2017-07-10 across many cities but a direct download link was not confirmed in this pass.
candidates.why_useful: If the associated tomslee.net archive is still live, this is a pre-2015 Airbnb listing/price panel that predates Inside Airbnb's earliest coverage -- would directly fill gap #1 (historical dumps pre-2023, here pre-2015). Worth a follow-up check of tomslee.net directly since the repo itself has no committed data.
candidates.size_hint: unknown (data not in repo; would need tomslee.net)
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: predates our Inside Airbnb coverage, does not duplicate it

candidates.name: NLP Text Mining: Lisbon vs Rio de Janeiro Airbnb Portuguese reviews
candidates.what_it_holds: Master's thesis repo (42 commits) with a Datasets/ folder plus Sentiment_Analysis, Topic_Modeling, and Topic_Inference_by_Sentiment folders. Abstract states the study analyzed 200,000 reviews published between 2010 and 2025 for Lisbon (Sep 21 2025 snapshot) and Rio de Janeiro (Sep 26 2025 snapshot), sourced from Inside Airbnb -- i.e. a very recent (weeks-old at time of this scout) full review-date corpus for two cities not in our current 13-city + 123-market panels' most recent vintage.
candidates.why_useful: A committed, very recent (Sep 2025) Inside-Airbnb-derived review corpus with full 2010-2025 date range for Lisbon and Rio -- both cities outside our current panel -- directly usable as a review-count-over-time stays proxy and possibly a fresher vintage than what we hold for these markets.
candidates.geography: Lisbon, Portugal; Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: adds two markets (Lisbon, Rio) not in our 13-city or 123-market Inside Airbnb panels, with a fresher Sep-2025 vintage

candidates.name: Airbnb website history analysis - Rio de Janeiro
candidates.what_it_holds: CSV folder with 'Detailed Listings data for Rio de Janeiro' and 'Detailed Review Data for listings in Rio de Janeiro', sourced from Inside Airbnb, covering January 2010 through January 2020 per the repo's stated motivation (reportedly 330,000+ guest reviews per search-result description). Jupyter-notebook analysis on top. MIT-licensed code; last updated Feb 2023.
candidates.why_useful: A committed, city-specific long review-date panel (2010-2020) for Rio de Janeiro, a market not in our current 13-city Inside Airbnb panel -- usable as a stays-proxy time series and a cross-check against the giselesilva 2025-vintage Rio snapshot above.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: adds a market (Rio) not in our panel, but coverage stops 2020, so mainly useful as a historical baseline

candidates.name: Airbert BnB Dataset Downloader
candidates.what_it_holds: Companion code (22 commits, MIT license) to the 'Airbert' vision-and-language-navigation pretraining paper. Downloads a large multi-city, multi-country Airbnb corpus (listing JSON, photo captions, optional reviews and extra property info) generated during a Christmas 2019 scrape, using a Wikipedia-derived list of regions. Authors state they cannot redistribute the actual LMDB data file (image licensing), so only the downloader/processing pipeline plus small precomputed TSV splits are in the repo -- no raw review corpus is committed.
candidates.why_useful: A ready-made, dozens-of-cities global Airbnb scraper/downloader (listings + reviews + captions) built and tested by an academic NLP/vision group, usable as a method reference for what fields are obtainable and how, though it scrapes airbnb.com directly (ToS question per repo rule 6) and ships no data itself.
candidates.last_activity: not precisely dated; 22 commits, appears maintained through the 2020-2021 paper period
candidates.geography: global, dozens of cities (region list scraped from Wikipedia)
candidates.size_hint: paper describes a large-scale multi-city corpus; exact row counts not in repo

candidates.name: Kraina Airbnb European accommodation dataset
candidates.what_it_holds: Hugging Face dataset (published by Kraina AI, a WUST geospatial/mobility research group, Apache-2.0 licensed tooling) of Airbnb accommodation offers from 10 European cities, originally supplementary material for the paper 'Determinants of Airbnb prices in European cities: A spatial econometrics approach.' Likely includes review-count/rating fields tied to listings (exact review-date granularity not confirmed in this pass) -- see https://huggingface.co/datasets/kraina/airbnb.
candidates.why_useful: An academically-curated, ready-to-load 10-European-city Airbnb dataset outside our current 13-city panel; the Kraina AI GitHub org (https://github.com/kraina-ai) also hosts the geospatial processing tooling used to build it, so it is GitHub-adjacent even though the data itself sits on HF.
candidates.time_coverage: not confirmed (tied to an academic paper snapshot)
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: possible overlap with our Inside Airbnb European cities; would need row-level check

candidates.name: Booking.com RecTour 2024 Reviews Challenge dataset
candidates.what_it_holds: RecTour 2024 (ACM RecSys workshop, co-located, Oct 18 2024) challenge dataset: 2,031,914 anonymized, dated user-generated reviews from 50,000 Booking.com accommodations, with guest and accommodation context fields. Distributed via the RecTour organizers / Hugging Face (Booking-com/accommodation-reviews) rather than a plain GitHub repo, but the RecTour workshop series (github search: RecTour, rectour24) hosts baseline code and challenge scaffolding on GitHub each year.
candidates.why_useful: A large, dated (review-timestamped), non-Airbnb short-term-lodging review corpus at real scale (2M+ reviews, 50k properties) -- a genuine competitor (Booking.com alternative-accommodation) reviews-over-time dataset that could be used the same way as an Airbnb reviews stays-proxy, for a peer-comparison read-through. This extends what we already hold (RecTour24 user dataset, 515k Booking hotel reviews) with the newer, larger 2024 accommodation-reviews release.
candidates.license: RecTour/Booking.com challenge terms (research use; check before any use)
candidates.time_coverage: dated reviews, span not confirmed in this pass
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: extends our existing RecTour24 / 515k Booking hotel reviews holdings with a newer, larger accommodation-reviews release

candidates.name: Neutrality May Matter: sentiment in Airbnb, Booking, and Couchsurfing reviews (Brazil/USA)
candidates.what_it_holds: Academic paper (Santos, Mota, Benevenuto, Silva; Social Network Analysis and Mining, 2020) that collected and sentiment-scored reviews across three platforms -- Airbnb, Booking.com, and Couchsurfing -- for matched cities in Brazil and the USA. No GitHub code/data repository was found in this pass (search returned only ResearchGate/arXiv/Semantic Scholar mirrors of the paper itself); flagged as a lead worth a direct-author-page or arXiv-supplementary check rather than a confirmed repo.
candidates.why_useful: If a companion repo/dataset surfaces, this would be a rare cross-platform (Airbnb vs. hotel-OTA vs. peer-to-peer) matched-city review corpus, useful for a sharing-economy vs. traditional-lodging sentiment/positivity-bias read that could bear on review-count-based demand proxies (why review positivity may differ between Airbnb and Booking, biasing simple review-count comparisons).

candidates.name: google-play-scraper (JoMingyu)
candidates.what_it_holds: Python library for pulling Google Play Store app metadata, ratings, rating-count histories, and full review text/timestamps for any app ID via public endpoints (no scraping of restricted pages), handling pagination beyond the 200-review batch limit. Generic tool, not Airbnb-specific, but trivially pointed at the Airbnb Android app package to pull rating trend and dated user reviews.
candidates.why_useful: A clean, general-purpose, non-Airbnb-site method to build an Airbnb app rating/review-count time series as an engagement/usage proxy -- directly addresses gap #5 (app rankings/engagement history) without touching airbnb.com, so it is not a rule-6 ToS question the way a direct Airbnb-site scraper would be.
candidates.license: check repo (commonly MIT for this class of tool; not independently confirmed)
candidates.last_activity: actively used by community (exact date not confirmed)
candidates.time_coverage: live, current reviews plus historical rating counts where exposed by the API

candidates.name: app-store-scraper (facundoolano)
candidates.what_it_holds: Node.js package to pull iTunes/Apple App Store app reviews (dated, rated) and version/ranking history for any app ID via Apple's public endpoints. Generic tool with a large fork ecosystem (Python ports exist, e.g. app-store-web-scraper).
candidates.why_useful: Same rationale as the Google Play scraper above but for iOS -- lets us build an Airbnb iOS app review-count/rating time series as an engagement proxy (gap #5) without touching airbnb.com.

notes: This theme is heavily saturated with single-city, single-snapshot Kaggle-NYC/Seattle/Boston re-analysis notebooks with zero new data -- excluded per instructions (dozens seen, e.g. denizn/AirBnb-Kaggle-Data-Analysis, KailasH1245/Airbnb_Data, AzanHaroon, sevesilvestre, gurezende, etc.). The strongest true finds were: (1) academic/thesis repos that commit a genuine multi-year Inside-Airbnb-derived reviews.csv for a city outside our current 13-city/123-market panel (Lisbon+Rio 2010-2025 giselesilva repo is the best of these -- very fresh Sep-2025 vintage); (2) pre-Inside-Airbnb historical scraping efforts (Tom Slee 2013-2017, UBDC since 2020) where the CODE is on GitHub but the DATA is either not committed to the repo or access-restricted -- these need a direct check of tomslee.net and researchdata.gla.ac.uk download links respectively, which I could not fully resolve via web search/WebFetch alone (worth a follow-up scout with browser access); (3) generic, non-Airbnb-site app-store review scrapers (Google Play, Apple App Store) as a clean route to gap #5 (Airbnb app engagement history) since they don't touch airbnb.com. I found no GitHub repo committing a large (100k+) multi-city Airbnb reviews corpus with full text AND recent vintage AND multiple years -- the RecTour24/Booking.com 2M-review 2024 challenge dataset is the closest thing at real scale, but it's Booking.com not Airbnb. I did not find any Reddit r/airbnb or r/AirBnBHosts dump repos, nor any Airbnb Community Center forum scrape, nor any working Wayback-Machine-based historical Airbnb review reconstruction tool. A dedicated browser-based (not web-search) pass on tomslee.net's actual data-download page, and on GitHub code search directly for 'reviews.csv' + 'insideairbnb' path filters, would likely surface more than search-engine indexing does for this theme -- GitHub's own search (blocked for this modality) would probably do much better than Google/Bing indexing of GitHub content, which seems to favor recently-updated/popular repos over older data-bearing ones.
